maria-s: quick q — ops wants to know if we should do auto-rotate KEKs or manual rewrap for the big dataset migration next quarter. tradeoffs?
ashley-sec: auto-rotate is safer for key compromise windows, but rewrap is cheaper for large static blobs. depends on our SLA for re-encryption throughput.
jordan-eng: embedding caches are the tricky part — rewrapping every object will blow I/O and invalidate caches. can we do lazy rewrap on read? :thinking_face:
tim-crypto: lazy rewrap is viable, but need to handle mixed-envelope formats during transition. plan needs compatibility header + version negotiation in envelope metadata.
maria-s: what about RBAC? If we switch to auto-rotate in KMS, do we need new service roles for the rewrap agent?
ashley-sec: yes — least privilege role for rewrap agent, limited to specific buckets/prefixes + rewrap action. add a short-lived session approach and log each rewrap to audit.
sre-bot: reminder: rewrap operations must include structured audit event: {actor, source, key_id_old, key_id_new, object_path, result} (example schema sent to ops).
jordan-eng: can we throttle rewrap and run canaries? propose: 0.5% early rollout -> validate read latency + correctness -> 10% -> 50% -> full. add fallback to on-demand lazy rewrap.
maria-s: timing — customers with Dedicated will expect zero-visible downtime. can we guarantee that during canary reads fall back to previous KEK if decryption fails?
tim-crypto: yes, runtime should attempt decrypt with new KEK header then fallback to old KEK decryption path. add metric for fallback rate and alert if >0.1%.
ashley-sec: vuln triage note — if we detect key exposure, manual immediate rewrap with emergency RBAC revoke + rotation should be supported. runbook update needed.
jordan-eng: ops-bot, can you add a task to update runbook and schedule a preflight simulation in staging?
ops-bot: created TASK-4821: preflight rewrap sim, includes perf markers and audit log checks. ETA: next Tue. :white_check_mark:
maria-s: also check embedding cache evictions cost — add estimate of token/embedding recompute cost to the preflight checklist.
ashley-sec: good call. also update compliance checklist for cross-cloud KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) differences on rotate policies and envelope metadata constraints.
tim-crypto: final: prefer hybrid — use scheduled auto-rotate for KEK itself and orchestrate staged manual rewraps for large customer blobs with lazy fallback. document ops gating and RBAC for rewrap agent.
maria-s: thanks — i'll collate notes and draft the runbook, will ping this thread for review. :thumbsup:
